notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1]The demo received changes![/h1][p]Hello everyone, I hope you're having a great month so far. Today I wanted to make a list of all the changes we made for The Dancer's Lullaby DEMO.[/p][h2]
Visual changes[/h2][list][*][p] All the characters have received changes in their sprites, adding more shading to them.[/p][/*][*][p]We made a small redesign to Edith.[/p][/*][*][p]Flower sprites have been updated with better shading.[/p][/*][*][p]The City of Coma received a complete revamp.[/p][/*][*][p]The Norma Wall received some small changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Key sprites have been updated with better shading.[/p][/*][*][p]The dirty jacket design was changed.[/p][/*][*][p]The damaged coat design was changed.[/p][/*][*][p]We added missing death animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Elene's Shelter now has a small animation.[/p][/*][*][p]We added a sprite for the timer which used to be a black bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Pause menu now is animated.[/p][/*][*][p]We added sprites for the save slots.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay changes[/h2][list][*][p]Now there's an inventory limit of 10. It can be expanded with handbags.[/p][/*][*][p]We fixed some errors related to The City of Coma, now you can avoid certain encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]We fixed small errors related to the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]If your awareness level is below the required amount in The City of Coma you will die immedietly instead of having to wait for your demise.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other changes[/h2][list][*][p]We changed the soundtrack for The Halos Ruins.[/p][/*][*][p]We changed the soundtrack for The City of Coma.[/p][/*][*][p]We changed the track "The Empty Cabinet".[/p][/*][*][p]The game is now available for Mac and Linux.[/p][/*][*][p]There was a soft-lock in The City of Coma, it was fixced.[/p][/*][*][p]Grammar errors were fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Missing backgrounds were fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The description of the eyes, stats and certain clothing changed.[/p][/*][*][p]We added achievements.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Devlog[/h2][p]I started uploading videos related to The Dancer's Lullaby so you can follow the development of the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you for reading.[/h3][p]We are working in a new update for the demo while I type this btw.[/p][p]

[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We added translations!
notes.content:
[h1]Japanese, Spanish, Russian and more![/h1]
[h2]
TRANSLATIONS[/h2]

Hello everyone, today we bring you translations for The Dancer's Lullaby:
[list]
[*] Japanese
[*] Spanish
[*] Italian
[*] Russian
[*] Portuguese
[/list]

[b]These translations aren't perfect[/b] but we wanted to allow people all around the world be able to enjoy this game. If you can help translate the game better than we did please contact us through our email and feel free to sent us your translation so we can implement it: [i]miss.mementos@gmail.com[/i]

notes.title: The City of Coma Update
notes.content:
[h2]THE CITY OF COMA[/h2]
[i]"Welcome to Coma..."[/i]

Hello everyone, I hope you're enjoying the demo and all the horrors the world of TDL has to bring you. After a few weeks after it release I've been working on improving certain aspects of the game.

One of the most extensive sections of the demo is The City of Coma, this dangerous abandoned city covered in fog and plagued with enemies and mysteries. It introduces important mechanics to the player suchs as puzzle solving and finding important items to progress.

So here it is, the first update for The Dancer's Lullaby!
[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] The City of Coma looks more terrifying with darker lighting and new visuals
[*] Small fix on certain dialogues that were missing words
[*] Small change on the visuals of The Norma Wall
[*] Elene's animations have been updated to match the resolution of her other sprites
[*] The desing of the "Dirty Jacket" have changed.
[/list]

Enjoy all the changes, we will bring more updates as the time goes. Good luck surviving the horrors.
